text_block_list.text:
One day, Special Week invites me out to
the
beach.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer! This way! I'm over here!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There's someone I'd like you to meet
today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, the person in question is...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My other mom!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, let me take you back to when I
was a little
kid...

text_block_list.name: Young Spe
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Mom... why are we at the beach?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Because, dear... you said you wanted to
see your
other mother.

text_block_list.name: Young Spe
text_block_list.text: But my other mom... is already...

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Your mother and I would often come
here to talk
whenever something was
bothering either one of
us...

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Even now, whenever I'm feeling lost, I
come here
to talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Young Spe
text_block_list.text: You talk to my other mom?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It's true I can't see her, but
she's
definitely here. I know it... I can
feel it.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Go on, speak up if you've got something
to tell
her. I'm sure she'll hear you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, I started coming to the
beach
whenever I felt like talking to my
other mom.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's a little late now, but I remembered I
hadn't
introduced you yet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ideally, I wanted us to be in Hokkaido
for this,
but I guess all the seas are
connected.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she's listening, even from here!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mamaaa! This person here is my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My trainer's kind, smart, and always
supportive of
me and my dreams! So rest
assured—I'm in the
best of hands!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mamaaa! I'm so glad to attend Tracen
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I finally got to tell her. I wonder
if she'll be
happy for me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, you should say something to
her too,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she'd like to talk with you!

There's only one thing I need to tell her
mother.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hehe. Let's do our best to rise to
the top!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything else you want to tell
my other
mom? Something about me, for
example?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Like, "She's really giving it her all," or,
"Her dance
skills have improved a lot."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What?! I don't eat that much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-well... I guess I go little bit overboard
when the
food's really good...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Mom did tell me that Mama was a light eater.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So how's it that I ended up with such a
big
appetite?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gasp! What if my overeating is a reaction to Mama's undereating?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, then...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mamaaa! I'll eat enough for the both of
us!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll eat lots of tasty food so I can stay
healthy an'
happy!

Her big voice resounds far across the
sea. There's
no doubt her other mother
will continue to watch
over her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're making it sound like I'm some
klutz who
gets hurt all the time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What're you looking away for?! I am not a klutz!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Although I do have my clumsy
moments...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gasp! What if I inherited my clumsiness from Mama?!
Splash!

Suddenly, a large wave comes crashing
down on
Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh no... Mamaaa! I'm sooo sorry!

Her loud apology resounds far across the
sea. It
might be a coincidence—or
perhaps it's my
imagination at play—but
the waves seem a little
calmer now.
